name: django-crispy-forms-scoped-render-safety-policies
instr:
django-crispy-forms cannot currently bound rendering resources or restrict template and widget choices. Add opt-in render policies whose invocation and helper policies compose restrictively and share one isolated budget through nested rendering.

Reports contain final HTML, successfully rendered field identities, maximum actual layout depth, and exact output length. Rejections raise `RenderPolicyViolation`, catchable as `CrispyError`, with the breached constraint and relevant layout, field, or template; rejected work is not counted.

The active policy governs `BasicNode` form resolution, `CrispyFieldNode` widget mutation, and `SpecialSpacelessNode` text rewriting before output is returned or forbidden mutation occurs, as well as the crispy form, error, and field filters, `render_field`, and complete `FormHelper` rendering. For string fields and nested renderable objects, `render_field` counts only successfully dispatched fields and charges all produced text. Generic layouts and Bootstrap `PrependedAppendedText`, `FieldWithButtons`, holders, tabs, accordions, buttons, alerts, and modals count each contribution once while preserving error-selected containers and extra context.

Evaluate the current recursive tree, including custom templates and attributes changed by `LayoutSlice` wrapping, grouping, replacement, or updates, using stable child-index paths. Without a policy, preserve outputs, mutations, exceptions, whitespace, traversal order, and pointer transformations.
